description: Find a named person's LinkedIn profile: its URL with their current title, company and location. Give their first and last name, plus their company (name or website) and/or job title when you know them. A name only one person has is found from the name alone; when several people share it, the answer says how many and nothing is charged, so call again with their company or job title. Spends 2 credits, refunded if no confident match is found.

company_or_domain.description: The company they work at, as its name or website (acme.com). Needed for a name several people share, together with or instead of job_title.

job_title.description: Their job title ("Head of Sales"). Tells apart people who share a name, together with or instead of company_or_domain.

name: find_linkedin_profile
title: Find a LinkedIn profile
